text:
nina: kicking off a follow-up chat on safe fallback primitives after the canary controller meeting. goal: design a compact "degeneration" pathway to recover capacity under memory-heavy variants without immediate rollback. notes below.

sam: nice. rough idea was a proxy-relay that can optionally strip nonessential request state (prefix KV, long context blobs) so heavier variants can serve more QPS. it sits behind the router and is opt-in by deg-signal header.

marta: question: how do we avoid different semantics? stripping prefix can change outputs for context-dependent tasks. we need a quality gating mechanism before switching live traffic to strip-mode.

raj: yeah, two big tradeoffs: (1) ops cost of running proxy-relay fleet, (2) behavioral divergence for stripped requests. recommend we only enable strip-mode if mirrored trial shows <0.5% semantic drift on sampled prompts.

lee: for detection, emit a small sample digest + prefix_len as tracing tags. don't send raw context. sample at 0.05% of requests and roll up to drift buckets. this keeps cardinality low.

nina: fallback triggers proposal: three signals (latency spike, error-rate, sampled quality regression). fallback triggers when 2/3 are breached within a sliding 3-minute window. that should reduce flapping.

sam: in private deployments the proxy-relay can be deployed as a sidecar; deg-signal originates from local rollout controller so we don't cross tenant boundaries. packaging + lifecycle hooks required.

marta: we also need a session-affinity rule: keep pinned sessions to original backend; only stateless or read-only requests may be routed to proxy-relay. add header `X-Deg-Handled: strip` from relay when applied.

raj: telemetry note: use reservoir sampling for sample digests to avoid cardinality blowup. store hashes in a telemetry store and compute drift heuristics asynchronously.

lee: operational checklist idea: (1) enable mirror-only 10% to proxy-relay (no strip), (2) run equivalence check, (3) enable strip-mode for 1% with circuit-breaker, (4) scale as needed.

ops-bot: canary job queued: canary/proxy-relay/mirror -> staging (job id: 65782).

nina: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with config examples and operator checklist. will propose default deg_policy in Redwood: 

```yaml
deg_policy:
  mirror_pct: 10
  strip_enable_pct: 1
  sampling_pct: 0.05
  thresholds:
    latency_ms: 600
    error_rate_pct: 2.0
  fallback_condition: at_least_two
```

sam: please also include a small snippet for the router pseudocode and the header contract so external components can interoperate.

marta: tagging @raj and @lee for review. quick thumbs if you agree. :thumbsup:
